fields.name: heading

fields.description: Two lines at most. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: scrollLabel
fields.label: Scroll label
fields.description: The label beside the mouse icon. Warning: text longer than 12 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: The small line at the top of the card. Only the first 3 Stat Cards are shown. Warning: text longer than 32 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: statValue
fields.label: Stat value
fields.description: The big figure, e.g. 1,000+ or 44 YRS. Warning: text longer than 8 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Two lines at most under the figure. Warning: text longer than 80 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: The office photo behind the whole section. Route steps: you may add multiple steps, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site.

fields.name: backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Describes the photo for screen readers. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Two lines at most. Warning: text longer than 38 characters is cut short with “…”.
fields.value: THE ROAD IS NEW. HERE’S THE ROUTE IN.

fields.name: stepNumber
fields.label: Step number
fields.description: Warning: You may add multiple steps, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site. The number, e.g. 01: at most 3 characters.

fields.name: stepHeading
fields.label: Step title
fields.description: Warning: text longer than 30 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: stepDescription
fields.label: Step description
fields.description: Three lines at most. Warning: text longer than 105 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The block shows up to 3 Showcase Items: items added after the third are not shown on the page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: The powertrain's name, shown as the heading above its description (e.g. Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Plain text, shown as the paragraph below the title.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots (+ points)
fields.description: Up to 4 bullets, one per + point, written as: x, y | TITLE | description. x and y are percentages of the showcase image from its bottom-left corner (0, 0), x to the right and y upwards; "40" and "40%" mean the same, and a missing value counts as 0. Bullets after the 4th are not shown.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background visual (shown blurred with an ambient glow)

fields.name: nav_brand
fields.label: Navigation: logo text
fields.description: Shown as the JSW MOTORS logo when it reads JSW MOTORS.

fields.name: nav_links
fields.label: Navigation: links
fields.description: A bulleted list of links (e.g. NEV TECH, NEWSROOM).

fields.name: body_cta
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The bottom-right button.

fields.name: media_footerVariant
fields.label: Footer layout
fields.description: Variant A: the photo (or video) behind; the logo, copyright and button at the left, the columns and social icons at the right. Variant B: the black-to-teal gradient (no photo); the logo, copyright and privacy policy at the left, the button in the centre, CONNECT (the social links as text) and the columns at the right. Columns and Icons: add them to this block.

fields.name: media_backgroundMode
fields.label: Background type
fields.description: Image: the background image. Video: the background video, playing muted on a loop (the background image shows until it plays, and instead of it if it cannot). Image and video: both the background image and the background video (shown as Video for now).

fields.name: media_backgroundImage
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Covers the whole footer (with Video, or Image and video: shown until the video plays).

fields.name: media_backgroundImageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty when the image is decoration only. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: media_backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: An MP4 video from Assets, or its full URL. Used when Background type is Video, or Image and video.

fields.name: brand_logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark, white.

fields.name: brand_copyright
fields.label: Copyright text
fields.description: Under the logo, e.g. © 2026 JSW Motors  Mumbai, India. At most 60 characters.

fields.name: brand_ctaButton
fields.label: CTA button link
fields.description: Where the white button leads (a page, or #section on one).

fields.name: brand_ctaButtonText
fields.label: CTA button text
fields.description: The "+" after it is added on the page. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: brand_privacyPolicyText
fields.label: Privacy policy text
fields.description: At the foot, on the left. At most 30 characters.

fields.name: brand_socialHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: Above the social icons, e.g. CONNECT. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: columnHeading
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: e.g. TECHNOLOGY. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: links_link1
fields.label: Link 1 URL
fields.description: A page, #section, or a full URL. A link without a URL is not shown.

fields.name: links_link1Text
fields.label: Link 1 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: links_link2
fields.label: Link 2 URL
fields.description: A page, #section, or a full URL. A link without a URL is not shown.

fields.name: links_link2Text
fields.label: Link 2 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: links_link3
fields.label: Link 3 URL
fields.description: A page, #section, or a full URL. A link without a URL is not shown.

fields.name: links_link3Text
fields.label: Link 3 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: links_link4
fields.label: Link 4 URL
fields.description: A page, #section, or a full URL. A link without a URL is not shown.

fields.name: links_link4Text
fields.label: Link 4 text
fields.description: e.g. NEVs. At most 24 characters.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The network's logo, white on transparent (SVG or PNG). Warning: You can add multiple icons, but a maximum of 4 will be displayed on the live site.

fields.name: iconImageAlt
fields.label: Network name
fields.description: e.g. Facebook: read out by screen readers, and shown as the link in the Variant B layout. At most 30 characters.

fields.name: iconLink
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The JSW Motors profile on that network (full URL).

fields.name: brand
fields.label: Logo text
fields.description: JSW MOTORS shows as the JSW MOTORS wordmark, beside the JSW mark. At most 20 characters.

fields.name: homeLink
fields.label: Logo link
fields.description: Where the logo leads, e.g. the JSW home page.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Where the white button leads.

fields.name: ctaText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: At most 17 characters. Nav Links: you may add more, but at most 2 are shown on the pages (more do not fit in the bar).

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link URL
fields.description: A page, a section of one (/jsw-phase-3#nev-tech), or a full URL. At most 2 Nav Links are shown on the pages.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Link text
fields.description: At most 11 characters (on narrow tablets, under 700px wide, keep the texts short: about 8 characters per link).

fields.name: brand
fields.label: Brand: logo text as a link (e.g. JSW MOTORS -> home page)

fields.name: engine
fields.label: Centre engine image (shown first, fades out on scroll)

fields.name: text
fields.label: Centre headline and paragraph (revealed on scroll)

fields.name: image
fields.label: Card image (cards 1-6: top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)

fields.name: text
fields.label: Title and links (first link = primary CTA, further links = top-right pills)

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label (optional, not rendered; segments are generated from page sections)

fields.name: content_heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The first, grey line of the heading. Warning: text longer than 14 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: content_headingHighlight
fields.label: Heading: dark line
fields.description: The second, dark line of the heading. Warning: text longer than 14 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_placeholder
fields.label: Search box placeholder
fields.description: Warning: text longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_help
fields.label: Search box description
fields.description: The text under the search box (three lines at most). Warning: text longer than 130 characters is cut short with “…”.
fields.value: Search by role, team, or skill. New roles open up as the team grows, so check back soon for what’s new.

fields.name: search_filtersLabel
fields.label: Filters label
fields.description: The label above the filter dropdowns (the Filter items of this block). Warning: text longer than 20 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_emptyMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when no role matches the search and filters (two lines at most). Warning: text longer than 80 characters is cut short with “…”.
fields.value: No roles found matching your criteria.

fields.name: search_clearAll
fields.label: Clear all button
fields.description: Beside the filters label, once a filter option is ticked. Warning: text longer than 15 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_backToTop
fields.label: Back to top button
fields.description: Under the role list, once it is scrolled down. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: roleName
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: Warning: a title longer than 65 characters is cut short with “…” (two lines at most). Only the first 15 Job Roles are shown on the page.

fields.name: meta_department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Warning: text longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: meta_location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: As shown, e.g. Pune, India. The Locations filter matches its options against this. Warning: text longer than 20 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: meta_tags
fields.label: Other filter values
fields.description: Not shown: words for the other filters (e.g. Experience), separated by commas, e.g. 3-5 years, Full-time. At most 100 characters.

fields.name: button
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The application page or form for this role.

fields.name: buttonText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Warning: at most 15 characters, so the button keeps its size.

fields.name: categoryName
fields.label: Dropdown name
fields.description: Shown on the dropdown until options are ticked, e.g. Locations. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: filterField
fields.label: Matches the role's
fields.description: Which part of each Job Role the chosen option is looked for in.

fields.name: filterOptions
fields.label: Options
fields.description: The checkboxes of this dropdown: click Add for each one, e.g. Pune, India. Warning: an option longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers. At most 125 characters.

fields.name: position
fields.label: Place in the design
fields.description: Each place holds one image; an image without a place is not shown.

fields.name: media_background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Full-page landscape behind the card.

fields.name: media_foreground
fields.label: Foreground image
fields.description: The car filling the card, behind the text.

fields.name: content_subheading
fields.label: Personalized subheading
fields.description: Type {NAME} where the visitor's name goes, braces included; it is kept as written and filled in on the page.

fields.name: content_message
fields.label: Confirmation message
fields.description: Each sentence is shown on its own line. Type {email} where the visitor's email goes, braces included; it is kept as written and filled in on the page.
fields.value: We’ll message you when allocation opens. Your receipt is on its way to {email}.

fields.name: media_background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Full-page landscape behind the card.

fields.name: media_foreground
fields.label: Foreground image
fields.description: The car shown on the left half of the card.

fields.name: media_priceAmount
fields.label: Pricing: amount (₹)
fields.description: The reservation amount in rupees, e.g. 10000 or 10,000: shown as ₹10,000 and charged through Razorpay.

fields.name: media_priceBadge
fields.label: Pricing: badge
fields.description: The small tag beside the label; leave empty for none.

fields.name: media_priceNote
fields.label: Pricing: note
fields.value: Total payable today. Refundable until you confirm your order. You’ll complete payment securely with our payment partner.

fields.name: content_subheading
fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Allocation opens December 2026. Cars are assigned in the order reservations are placed.

fields.name: content_disclaimer
fields.label: Disclaimer text
fields.description: The small print below the button.
fields.value: JSW Motors processes this data only for the purpose above, under the DPDP Act, 2023. Consent is optional and you can withdraw it or request erasure anytime at privacy@jswmotors.com. Full Privacy Notice.

fields.name: form_action
fields.label: Form action URL
fields.description: Where the form data will be sent. Not used yet: the button currently goes straight to the Button link.

fields.name: form_cities
fields.label: City options
fields.description: The choices of the Select City list: click Add for each city.

fields.name: form_razorpayKey
fields.label: Razorpay Key ID
fields.description: The public Key ID only: rzp_test_… (testing) or rzp_live_… (live). NEVER enter the Key Secret here: everything in this block is published on the website.

fields.name: form_checkoutName
fields.label: Razorpay: name shown
fields.description: The name at the top of the Razorpay payment window.

fields.name: form_checkoutDescription
fields.label: Razorpay: description
fields.description: The line under the name in the Razorpay payment window.

fields.name: form_button
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The page opened after a successful payment (the confirmation page).

fields.name: form_failure
fields.label: Failure page link
fields.description: The page opened when the payment fails. (The Button link above is the page opened when it succeeds.)

fields.name: fields_cityPlaceholder
fields.label: City dropdown placeholder
fields.description: The first, empty choice of the city list (the cities are the City options field).
